body.x: Improv Electronics is unveiling two exciting new Boogie Board LCD eWriter models at the International Consumer Electronics Show next week .
Boogie Board LCD eWriters are the eco-friendly, electronic paperless replacement for memo pads, sketch books, scratch pads, note books and other writing and drawing mediums.

visit the Improv Electronics table (#D03) at the Showstoppers @ CES media event in the Lafite Ballroom at the Wynn Hotel for the opportunity to demo prototypes of the new Boogie Board LCD eWriter models.

Additional information about the two new products will be distributed via press release on Tuesday, January 8. The complete Boogie Board eWriter press kit will be available through the Virtual Press Office hosted by Showstoppers, Launch.it, CES media rooms and improvelectronics.com.
